Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misinterpreted the search results, incorrectly identifying Alfred Gell as German and Edmund Leach as Australian based on unreliable sources. This step matches the pattern of overreliance on low-credibility sources without adequately verifying information from authoritative references. The misclassification of their nationalities typically suggests the searcher may have inadvertently focused on tangential sources or lacked specificity in filtering out inaccurate data.
